name: get_text
title: Get text
description: Return the readable text of a tab as plain text with line breaks. Without selector it reads the <main> element, else the page's only <article>, else <body> without nav, header, footer and aside; with selector, the first matching element. Code in <pre> keeps its line breaks, and collapsed <details> and inactive tab panels are included; script, style and hidden elements are skipped, and iframes are not read. It runs BrowserHive's own reader, not page script, so it also works when evaluate is disabled. At most max_chars characters (default 20000) per call. Long results are paged: when truncated is true, call again with offset set to next_offset until next_offset is null.

selector.description: Read only the first element matching this selector (ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND when nothing matches).

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call (default 20000, at most 200000).

offset.description: Character offset to start from: pass the previous call's next_offset.
